title: MASC: A Tool for Mutation-Based Evaluation of Static Crypto-API Misuse Detectors
reasoning: The paper describes a tool for evaluating the performance of static crypto-API misuse detectors for software security. It does not evaluate or benchmark religion, morals, or ethics as a core component of its work. While security has ethical dimensions, the paper's focus is on technical aspects of security flaw detection, not an ethical or moral assessment of the detectors or their impact beyond technical performance.
